adaptation_table.local: Inline selection over all nonempty candidates without upstream post-processing/deduplication. Now includes saved reasoning and full answer text; invalid selection is recorded and falls back to nonempty highest-fitness candidate

code_changes: Record MAS-Zero API attempts with phase, logical ID, measured latency, usage availability and errors; disable hidden SDK retries.
Persist start/end events and candidates during execution, with unique per-attempt paths beneath the run/system artifact directory.
Enforce request/tool reservations and cooperative observed-token/wall thresholds; report unknown usage and overshoot.
Preserve partial MAS-Zero cost, candidate errors, meta/selection fallback diagnostics and budget-stop answers.
Remove unused final meta proposal, restore reasoning to self-selection, preserve multiline final answers, reject unsupported CL.
Use a shared exec namespace so generated helper definitions/imports are visible to forward.
Separate retrieval, rerank, calculator and total tool counts. Legacy logs keep their historical semantics.
Record per-metric denominators/statuses; failed empty answers get zero answer accuracy, judge failures stay missing.
Checkpoint questions incrementally; record source/data hashes, installed packages, requested/effective adapter options and ordered IDs.
Cost known events by actual model instead of pricing all phases as the node model; unknown usage yields unavailable total USD.
Add pinned FRAMES questions, verified HTML snapshot manifests, table/list parsing, URL aliases, chunk/source mapping and coverage reports.
Freeze disjoint FRAMES pilot/final IDs and provide reproducible offline preparation and estimate scripts.
Make retrieval imports lazy for offline tests; constrain logly below incompatible 0.2.
accounting_limits: Only MAS-Zero helper calls have new request-level enforcement. Other adapters explicitly reject resource_limits.
Generated Python is not isolated: imports can bypass helpers, introspection can access the host process, and infinite loops are not interrupted by cooperative wall checks.
No cross-process ledger/proxy yet covers AutoMAS, ADAS, single_agent or MCP; matched execution-budget comparisons are not ready.
Token caps are observed-usage stopping thresholds with output reservations, not hard billing ceilings. In-flight input usage can overshoot.
Network timeout bounds transport operations, not arbitrary Python execution or a strict full-request wall deadline.
Missing provider usage is unknown, not free; partial external-framework costs and failed external-judge requests are not fully instrumented.
Request phase latency sums and end-to-end question wall time are distinct. CL construction/amortization for other frameworks remains work.
Event append/flush protects against ordinary process failure, not guaranteed machine-power-loss durability. Unmatched starts require reconciliation.
Embedding model repository revisions remain unpinned; index metadata records this as null.

frames.coverage_status: Full frozen snapshot parsed: 2486 distinct canonical articles, 72002 chunks; 30 missing references on 13 questions; 0 ambiguous aliases, 0 invalid HTML, 0 conflicting article versions. Build stopped before publishing corpus/index. No questions were removed.
frames.index_status: Not built; embedding/reranker models and full retrieval dependencies not installed
frames.raw_url_gap_note: 30 source references on 13 questions absent before canonical alias resolution; 28 use en.m.wikipedia.org, which the examined upstream downloader regex does not match. Two remaining URLs are in url_mapping.json but have no HTML file. Four frozen final IDs are affected; selection remains unchanged.
frames.required_next_step: Repair the frozen corpus with versioned missing articles and documented provenance, or explicitly approve a protocol that retains the coverage gaps. Do not silently alter sampled IDs or substitute live pages. A replacement benchmark remains a separate decision.
